steps.title: Create the fractured starting base
steps.instruction: Follow the selected executable self-fracture synthesis for Primordial Bond. Use the returned Fracturing Orb policy; a wrong permanent fracture follows the returned reacquire/reprepare recovery.

steps.instruction: Use Orb of Alteration until one desired modifier appears in a state the selected policy keeps.

steps.title: Fill the Magic item when needed
steps.instruction: Use Orb of Augmentation when the selected policy wants another Magic affix before promotion.

steps.title: Promote the keepable Magic states
steps.instruction: Use Regal Orb only for the one-target Magic states the selected policy promotes; otherwise continue rolling. Expand Decision details when exact current affixes matter.
